check_package_for_malware: check if an MCP server package launched via npx or uvx has known malware advisories
create_function_infer_ecosystem: create a function that infers the package ecosystem (npm or PyPI) from a command name like npx or uvx
test_parse_npm_package: test parsing an npm package name with optional scope and version from a command argument token
build_function_query_osv: build a function that queries the OSV API for MAL-* malware advisories on a given package and ecosystem
review_parse_pypi_package: review the PyPI package parser that extracts name and version from tokens like name[extras]==version
